{
  "name": "my-project",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "E-ticaret uygulaması - HudHudScript",
  "main": "main.hudhud",
  "author": "Davut Süleyman",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": ["ecommerce", "hudhudscript", "turkish"],
  "dependencies": {
    "cebir": "^1.0.0",
    "fizik": "^1.0.0",
    "kimya": "^1.0.0"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "start": "hudhudscript run main.hudhud",
    "dev": "hudhudscript run --watch main.hudhud",
    "test": "hudhudscript test tests/",
    "build": "hudhudscript compile main.hudhud",
    "package": "hudhudscript package create"
  }
}
